attack: Use melee weapons in combat to improve your accuracy. Check a weapon's Bladework requirement before equipping it.
strength: Use melee combat to improve melee damage. Weapons and equipment can also increase your damage.
defence: Train through combat to improve your ability to survive. Compare armour requirements and defensive bonuses in Equipment.
hitpoints: Gain combat experience to improve your health. Bring food and watch incoming damage; a larger health pool does not replace healing.
ranged: Equip compatible ranged weapons and ammunition, then fight enemies. Check your supply of ammunition before a long run.
magic: Select a magic loadout and carry the required runes. Glyphcraft supplies runes, and equipped spell patterns can alter Sorcery attacks.
prayer: Open Devotion to choose rites and inspect their bonuses and point costs. Active rites consume Devotion points during combat.
slayer: Choose a Huntsman task and defeat its assigned enemies. Check the task's requirements, progress and rewards on its screen.
corruption: Choose a Blight activity and read its requirements and tradeoffs. Its rewards and magic can come with risks, so check the activity details.
woodcutting: Select an unlocked tree and start chopping. Logs go to Storage and can supply Kilncraft, Bowyering and other recipes.
fishing: Select a fishing activity and start catching fish. Raw catches can be cooked into food; inspect each activity for its level and output.
mining: Select a vein and mine its output. Copper and Tin Ore are the first materials for Bronze Bars in Forgecraft.
farming: Open the farm, plant suitable seeds in a plot, and return when the crops are ready. Inspect plots and growing options for their requirements.
firemaking: Select a Kilncraft activity and use logs to make the listed outputs. Check the required log type and quantity first.
cooking: Select a recipe and cook its raw ingredients. The resulting food restores health in combat; check success chance and supplies on the recipe.
smithing: Smelt ore into bars, then use those bars in equipment recipes. Select a recipe to see the required materials and level before starting.
fletching: Turn suitable materials into bow and ammunition recipes. Read each recipe's inputs and outputs before training.
crafting: Choose an Artifice recipe to work materials into equipment or accessories. Item details show equipment requirements and bonuses.
runecrafting: Use Glyphcraft activities to make runes. Inspect each recipe's materials; runes support Sorcery, Runescribing and other magic systems.
herblore: Choose an Apothecary recipe and collect its herbs and other ingredients. Potions and consumables have different effects; read their item details.
thieving: Choose an unlocked target and check its success chance and rewards. Targets can provide different goods, including seeds; risk and yield vary.
agility: Use Wayfaring activities and review the obstacle system for costs and bonuses. Compare obstacle effects before building a course.
summoning: Review Beastbinding recipes and familiar requirements. Tablets and familiars can support skills or combat; check their effects and materials.
astrology: Study Starreading activities and inspect constellations for bonuses. Bonuses and their costs are shown by the constellation controls.
alt_magic: Choose a Runescribing spell and check its rune and material costs. Different spells convert resources, make gold or provide other effects.
township: Open Settlement to inspect buildings, construction costs and resource production. Build with your available resources and check what each building contributes.
cartography: Open Surveying and use the frontier map and chart activities. Inspect a chart's requirements and progress before choosing it.
archaeology: Choose an excavation activity and inspect available dig sites. Different sites offer different finds; check the site and activity requirements.
harvesting: Choose a Prospecting activity to gather the listed materials and essences. Specialist essences can support Attunement.
echo_keeping: Choose an Echo Keeping activity and read its inputs and rewards. Inspect the skill's controls to manage echoes and their bonuses.
wayfolding: Choose Wayfolding activities and inspect their route and anchor requirements. Use the skill's system controls to manage what you unlock.
fermentation: Select a Fermentation recipe and gather its listed ingredients. Inspect the resulting brew or concentrate for its use and effects.
customcraft: Select a Customcraft activity and check the associated custom's requirements and rewards. Use the system controls to manage available traditions.
lostfinding: Select a Lostfinding activity and inspect its case and search requirements. Different cases can lead to different recovered items.
ranching: Open Husbandry to manage animal pens. Review each animal's needs and collect produce; pens can also provide hides, manure and breeding opportunities.
inscription: Use Scribing recipes to turn paper and ink into texts and glyphs. Check research requirements and item quality information on the activity.
engineering: Install devices and supply their required fuel and materials. Check each device's production and collect its output from the Engineering controls.
enchanting: Use Attunement to enchant equipment with suitable essence and other ingredients. Disenchanting unwanted equipment yields essence but destroys that piece.
dreamwalking: Allocate offline time to a dream and return to collect its results. Spend Dream Essence in the Dream Bazaar and explore the connected Dream Realm.
caravaneering: Prepare a caravan with the available wagon and guards, choose a route, and inspect its journey map. Return to collect results and rewards.
riftkeeping: Select a rift and compare the safe, balanced and overcharged extraction choices. Check the screen for the costs, risks and aether rewards.
spellweaving: Use aether and runes to create spell patterns. Equip an available pattern to change how your Sorcery attacks behave.
